limitations: Outcome-known erasure of only negative daily components is a perfect hindsight oracle, not a decision-time feature
The old account path, holdings, own-state risk feedback, direct fees and NAV are held fixed; this is not a new native account
Available/full-minute drawdown, CVaR5, corrected block lower, 2/5bp and forward evidence are not evaluated
All 819 rolling windows overlap and cannot be treated as independent trials
The per-day negative-loss erasure is stronger than the earlier per-window net-component erasure and the fractions are not comparable
Passing only wealth/year/window accounting under hindsight does not establish any v2 strategy gate as met
